title: Only One Way
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Only One Way | Jesus Christ, the Son of God, truth, and salvation by grace - John v14:6

Jesus Christ is the only way to the Father, and our faith must rest in the true and living God revealed through the Son. From John v14:6 and the wider witness of John’s Gospel, we are reminded that God is not distant, unknowable, or changing. In Jesus, the Father is made known, and eternal life is found through Him alone.

The heart of the gospel stands firm: God loved the world, gave His only begotten Son, and sent Him in the flesh to bear our sin and rise again. That truth separates biblical Christianity from every false hope. We are not saved by works, fear, or uncertainty, but by grace through faith in Christ.

So we must be discerning, grounded in God’s Word, and bold without bitterness. Truth is not unloving when it points us to the Savior. As we draw near to the last days, we hold fast to the gospel, stand against deception, and confess with confidence that salvation is in Jesus Christ alone.
